newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Golden Frontier in Vietnam venture.
newsitem.headline: Golden Frontier in Vietnam venture.

text.p: Malaysia's Golden Frontier Bhd said on Monday it is venturing into Vietnam for the manufacturing of corrugated fibreboard cartons.
In a statement, Golden Frontier said it will take up a 35 percent stake in Carisan Wawasan Sdn Bhd, which in turn holds a 70 percent equity in Alcamax Packaging (Vietnam) Co Ltd.
The license from the Vietnamese Ministry of Planning and Investment approving Alcamax to be a 100 percent foreign owned company for the manufacture of corrugated cartons has been obtained, it said.

Golden Frontier said initial capital investment of Alcamax is $5.0 million and is expected to gradually increase to $15.0 million. The company's investment in Carisan Wawasan will be funded from internal funds, it said.
